facts.text: A slow, man-eating giant lives in an oversized stone cottage in the woods north of Brandonsford, on the party's route toward the Barrow. He captured Brother Dirk there to cook in a stew, and he is now awake and has seen the party rob him of his captive.

classification.negative_outcome_clarity_justification: Dirk says the giant meant to eat him in a stew, so capture and being eaten is the specific identifiable harm to travelers in these woods.
classification.outcome_severity_justification: Being captured and eaten is death.
classification.evidentiary_strength_justification: The party directly saw the giant with a bound captive and a cooking pot, and Dirk testified to its intent.
classification.evidence_of_progression_justification: The giant has captured a traveler before and is awake and aware of the party, but it gave up the chase, and nothing shows it hunting them now.
classification.preventability_justification: The giant is slow and was easily outrun, and its cottage's location is known, so the party can avoid it or prepare.
